title: Case Notes on Registered Guest Stays and Estimated Water Reads — Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
**Rule.** When an estimated water read is set on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, a guest stay registered with the community under the site's Community Rules & Site Care record bears on the estimate. Where the most recently begun guest stay registered with the community began in the last two months and its planned last day falls fourteen or more days after its first day, the estimate is raised to 125 percent (a multiplier of 1.25); where that stay began in the last two months and its planned last day falls fewer than fourteen days after its first day, the estimate is raised to 110 percent (a multiplier of 1.1); without a registered guest stay begun in the last two months no guest share applies to the estimate.

**Terms.** The stay read is the registered guest stay with the latest first day on the Community Rules & Site Care records. It began in the last two months when fewer than 2 whole months separate its first day from the handling date. The length test is the planned last day less the first day, in days: 14 or more, or fewer than 14. The share multiplies the estimated consumption as converted to the cycle, before the final figure is rounded.

## Cases (handling date 10 June, hypothetical)

| Most recently begun registered stay | Began in the last 2 months? | Planned last day less first day | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May to 20 May | Yes (1 whole month) | 19 days | 125 percent |
| 1 May to 15 May | Yes | 14 days | 125 percent |
| 1 May to 14 May | Yes | 13 days | 110 percent |
| 9 April to 30 April | No (2 whole months) | 21 days | none |
| 11 April to 18 April | Yes (1 whole month) | 7 days | 110 percent |

**Two stays registered (hypothetical).** A stay from 3 March to 31 March and a later stay from 20 May to 24 May: the stay read is the one that began on 20 May, the most recently begun; it began in the last two months and runs 4 days, so the share is 110 percent.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Converted figure 4.00 kgal with a 19-day stay begun on 1 May: 4.00 times 1.25 is 5.00 kgal.
